import numpy as np
M=10000.0; f1=1.9; w1=2*np.pi*f1; k1=M*w1**2; z1=0.004; c1=2*z1*np.sqrt(k1*M)
mu=0.05; m2=mu*M; f2=f1/(1+mu); w2=2*np.pi*f2; k2=m2*w2**2; z2=float(np.sqrt(3*mu/(8*(1+mu)**3))); c2=2*z2*np.sqrt(k2*m2)
print(f"f2={f2:.3f} Hz k2={k2:.0f} N/m c2={c2:.0f} Ns/m z2={z2*100:.2f} pct")
for F0 in [280.0, 1400.0]:
    a0=F0/(2*z1*M)
    # 2DOF at resonance approx via solve at w1
    w=w1
    import numpy.linalg as la
    A=np.array([[-M*w*w+1j*w*(c1+c2)+(k1+k2), -1j*w*c2-k2],[-1j*w*c2-k2, -m2*w*w+1j*w*c2+k2]],dtype=complex)
    X=la.solve(A,np.array([F0,0]))
    a1=abs(X[0])*w*w
    zeff=F0/(2*a1*M)
    print(f"F0={F0:.0f} N a_uncon={a0:.2f} m/s2 a_con={a1:.2f} m/s2 zeff={zeff*100:.2f} pct rel={abs(X[1]-X[0])*1000:.1f} mm")
